subject: License code under Apache-2.0 and data and material under CC0-1.0
description: Tobias stated on 2026-11-03 that project code is released under Apache 2.0 and data, information and other material under CC0 1.0, with third-party licences unaffected, and asked to change the repository where needed. The repository declared CC0-1.0 for its own code (LICENSE, pyproject.toml, README) and labelled pipeline images MIT. Scope: LICENSE becomes the Apache-2.0 text, the CC0 text moves to LICENSE-CC0, a NOTICE states which files fall under which licence, pyproject.toml declares Apache-2.0, the README licence section and the image labels follow, and a test holds them together. Not in scope: third-party files and their licences, per-file headers, the DES transfer plan. Review: Codex.
